subject: Purchase order formatting & monthly invoice batching request
messages:
From: Olivia Bennett <olivia.bennett@summit-analytics.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@summit-analytics.com
Date: 2026-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood SOW - PO format + consolidated monthly invoice

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Summit's team is keen to move forward. Procurement asked that I confirm a few billing / PO requirements before we start contracting:

- We need a formal Purchase Order (our standard template attached). All invoices must reference the PO number on every line item (not just header).
- Our standard terms are Net45. We can consider Net30 for certain vendors but that requires finance approval.
- We do consolidated monthly billing (one invoice per calendar month) rather than multiple smaller invoices.
- Please include Redwood's legal name, remit address, and EIN on the invoice. They also requested a W9 (if available).
- For vendor onboarding we need: primary AP contact, remit email, and a vendor code (if you have one).

Can Redwood accommodate these points? If Net45 is mandatory on your side, can we include an early-payment discount clause (e.g., 1% if paid within 15 days)? I attached our PO template for reference.

Appreciate a quick confirmation so procurement can raise the PO.

Best,
Olivia Bennett
Sr. Procurement Manager
Summit Analytics
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Bennett <olivia.bennett@summit-analytics.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood SOW - PO format + consolidated monthly invoice

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear list and the template. Quick answers below and a couple of options so procurement can pick what works: 

1) PO format / line-item PO number: we can put the PO number on every invoice line. Our billing system accepts a PO field and we can also include it in the line description.

2) Terms: Redwood standard is Net30, but for Reserved/Dedicated capacity deals we typically accept Net45 on contract. Given Summit is starting with a Dedicated pool, Net45 is workable with Sales/Finance sign-off.

- Option A: Accept Net45 as requested.
- Option B: Net30 with a 1% early-payment credit if paid within 15 days (favored by Finance — preserves cashflow).

3) Invoice cadence: We can produce one consolidated invoice per calendar month summarizing daily usage and attach a CSV with per-day token/usage lines. We can also provide a monthly PDF invoice plus the usage CSV.

4) W9 and vendor details: attaching a copy of our W9. Our AP contact is ap-payments@redwoodinference.com and remit address is in the attached doc. We do not have an external vendor code for Summit to assign; if you create one please send it and we'll add to our system.

If procurement is okay with either Option A or B, we'll proceed to get finance to approve the payment terms language and update the SOW. If you need a specific clause written (e.g., "1% early payment discount" language) we can draft and include during contract redlines.

Thanks — looping in Neha (Finance lead) and Karthik (Commercial Ops) to confirm on process side.

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Bennett <olivia.bennett@summit-analytics.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@summit-analytics.com
Date: 2026-03-23T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood SOW - PO format + consolidated monthly invoice

Diego — thanks for the quick reply and the W9. Procurement reviewed internally and here's where we landed: 

- We will issue a PO and expect Net45 terms reflected on the invoice. Net30 with early-pay credit would be fine if Redwood prefers, but procurement policy defaults to Net45.
- Consolidated monthly invoice is mandatory for our AP system. Please ensure the invoice file contains: PO number, invoice number, invoice date, total invoice amount, and line-level description with PO on each line.
- We will provide the vendor code after we raise the PO (you can leave a placeholder for now).

I attached an updated PO template with Summit's standard payment clause and signature block. Can you confirm Redwood can accept Net45 and consolidated monthly billing exactly as listed? If so we will route the PO and start the countersign.

Best,
Olivia

----- Attachment: SUMMIT_PO_TEMPLATE_v3.pdf -----
(attachment stub)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-24T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood SOW - PO format + consolidated monthly invoice

Forwarding the procurement confirmation from Summit. Quick internal note:

- Finance confirms we can accept Net45 for the first 12 months on Dedicated deals to win the account, provided Sales logs concession and we put an allowance for an early-pay discount in the contract (1% within 15 days) as a negotiated concession. That preserves some upside if they pay faster.
- Billing can produce consolidated monthly invoices with the attached usage CSV — Karthik, can Ops add a per-invoice CSV export to the SOW deliverable and confirm format? We'll need PO-number-on-line mapping enabled.
- Please get procurement to include the vendor code once they issue the PO. Also confirm whether Summit needs invoices sent to an AP mailbox (procurement@summit-analytics.com) or to a dedicated remit email.

I'll approve Net45 for the SOW with a recorded sales concession: 1% early-pay within 15 days (applies only to the first 12 months). If the deal expands to >$500k ARR we can re-evaluate terms.

— Neha Kapoor
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
